FAQ question 16 ke mutabiq, eligible hometown holder ek calendar year mein do LTC le sakta hai: ek eligible carry-over aur ek current sub-block ki concession.
FAQ ka example: 2026 mein 2024 se 2025 ki unavailed LTC aur 2026 se 2027 ki LTC, applicable carry-forward conditions ke saath li ja sakti hain.
FAQ question 17: headquarters aur hometown same hon, to chaar saal ke block ke pehle saal mein eligible previous block aur current block ki any place LTC possible ho sakti hai.
FAQ question 18 aur Rule 10 ko saath padhein: unavailed concession applicable conditions par agle block ke pehle calendar year mein carry forward ho sakti hai.
FAQ question 20: doosre NCR states ke shehron ko Delhi headquarters nahi maana jaata. Delhi headquarters se aise declared hometown ki LTC par FAQ ki conditions check karein.
Rule 9 ke mutabiq employee aur family members ek block mein alag groups aur alag times par travel kar sakte hain. Concession outward journey shuru hone wale block mein count hoti hai.
Return journey block ke baad ho to bhi Rule 9 outward journey wala block dekhta hai. Ye Rule 10 ke under carried-forward LTC par bhi apply hota hai.
Rule 10: unavailed LTC agle do ya chaar saal ke block ke pehle saal mein li ja sakti hai. Hometown eligible employee ki any place carry-forward par rule ka additional link bhi check karein.
Rule 10 ka second sentence any place carry-forward ko us four-year block ke second two-year hometown concession ke carry-forward se jodta hai. Worked example ke liye clarification lein.
Rule 11: employee aur family ke har member any place in India LTC par alag jagah choose kar sakte hain. Har journey ke liye applicable declaration aur conditions verify karein.
